description: (Na)₂LiPrCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiPrCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiPrCl₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PrCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.53 Å. Pr is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form PrCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Pr-Cl bond lengths are 2.73 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Pr atom.
